name: Hunt County, TX
findings: Hunt County has 191 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hunt County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 5 community organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
